notes:
Passed the fake-backend gate; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware backend was run. The card's ScpiDriver helper expresses the interface, so there is no shape deviation. The package covers the keysight33210A SCPI function generator (the first card entry symbol): frequency, amplitude, offset, waveform function, output termination and output relay, with the ':OUTP OFF' e-stop and safe-state command. NOT COVERED: the clone's other instrument classes (Keithley 24XX, Agilent U272xA, the multimeters and the DAQ), including the U272xA read_values and reset methods named in the card's hints; the 33210A duty-cycle field (the upstream also requires SQU) and its DC-voltage field (two commands with a load-dependent Vmax). amplitude and offset are operator_required; site-limits.example.json shows example operator bounds. The readback queries FREQ?, VOLT:OFFS? and :OUTP? are standard SCPI query forms that the upstream class does not show; they were not tried on an instrument. The fake is a stateful command responder in fake.py, not a recording and not an upstream simulator. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
